what: Prebuilt native NPU worker + its OpenMP runtime, for packaging.
why: The release runner has no usable XRT (Ubuntu noble's libxrt-dev is XRT 2.13 with the xrt/experimental/* header layout; this tree needs xrt/xrt_device.h >= 2.14, and AMD ships XRT as source/RPM only), so CI cannot compile npu_engine_universal. Without this the released tarball/.deb/AppImage/GHCR artifact ship CPU/GPU-only — issue #2360. Packaging prefers a freshly built worker and falls back to these files.
build_command: cmake -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_HIP_ARCHITECTURES=gfx1151 && cmake --build build --target npu_engine_universal -j8   # engine/npu project

runtime_deps.libxrt_coreutil.so.2: system XRT (/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib) — required on the host
runtime_deps.libxrt_core.so.2: system XRT (/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib) — required on the host
runtime_deps.libomp.so: bundled beside the worker; found via RUNPATH $ORIGIN / $ORIGIN/../lib/1bit

runpath: $ORIGIN:$ORIGIN/../lib/1bit:/opt/xilinx/xrt/lib(+the SDK venv path it was linked against)
regenerate: Re-run the build on a host with real XRT, then replace both files here and update the shas. Testing/npu_worker_bundle_selfcheck.py fails if the shas drift.
